evidence.role: Run initialization, candidate selection and four lair placements
Actor update, guardian state consumer and three ability consumers
Guardian wake, player-to-lair leash and reset decision

abi.state_helper: Win64 RCX=actor, RDX=lair position, R8=player position, XMM3=run clock; return AL in 0..3.
abi.decompiler_limit: Raw slices use a generic analysis ABI; inferred GCC parameter lists are not authoritative. The shared actor function contains indirect jumps whose arms were recovered from instructions and original jump-table words.

placement.run_gate: Lairs are initialized only when the native Game+0x958 flag is zero; no user-facing flag name is asserted here.
placement.candidate_indices: Zone 11 uses its explicit zone+0x48/+0x50 list. Other zones select enemies in original table order when byte+0x4c equals 1 and f32+0x48 is finite. An empty candidate list skips lairs.
placement.selection: For slot i, enemy=candidates[i % candidate_count]. This stage does not use RNG.
placement.explicit_points: Use a matching slot key in zone+0x38/+0x40, stride 16. Its Z is ADT, then WMO, then world fallback height.
placement.radius: The optional radius at zone+4 when zone byte+0 is nonzero; otherwise zone+0xd8.
placement.candidate_checks: Reject any blocked cell sampled at candidate XY plus each integer XY offset -2 through +2 inclusive. Missing grid and out-of-grid samples are unblocked. Require an ADT height and abs(candidate_z - resolved_center_z) < 30.
placement.fallback: After all five candidates fail, accept half-radius XY without repeating those checks; resolve Z through ADT, WMO, then world fallback.

state.actor_guardian_option: Actor+0x40 is Option<guardian state> using the timer Vec capacity -1 niche. Some has timer pointer+0x48/length+0x50, lair slot+0x58 and awake byte+0x60.
state.current_position: If actor movement duration+0x128 <= 0, use destination+0x118; otherwise interpolate start+0x10c to destination using clamp((clock-started_at+0x124)/duration, 0..1). State distances ignore Z.
state.lair_lookup_fallback: If actor lair index is outside Game+0x590, caller substitutes current actor position as home.
state.sleeping_to_awake: Current HP below maximum, or both current-to-home distance <= 3 and current-to-player distance <= 20. Sets awake byte and returns 1.
state.sleeping: Otherwise returns 0. Caller waits for its existing path to finish, then returns home only when farther than 2 XY units from home. Guardian ability timers do not advance here.
state.awake: Returns 3 while player-to-home distance <= 97.5. Guardian distance from the player is not the leash test.
state.reset: When already awake and player-to-home distance > 97.5, clear awake, restore HP to max, set periodic-effect vector length+0x10 to zero, and zero actor+0x98/+0x9c. Return 2. Caller installs a path home, sets next move time to arrival, cancels cast+0x70, and skips combat. Guardian ability timer values are retained.
state.wake_scaling: Return1 queues a GUID whose consumer recomputes current-time guardian health/damage. HP maximum only increases, preserving clamped health fraction; damage never decreases. Owning scope: wake-rescale.asm.

abilities.timer_semantics: After ordinary actor gates and guardian state results1/3, subtract delta seconds once; an ordered value <=0 emits one ability in slot order and resets to the repeat value. Overshoot is discarded. NaN timer comparisons skip emission.
abilities.low_health_repeat: When f32(max_hp * f32(0.3)) > hp, multiply repeat cooldowns by f32(0.7). Exact30/100 is below the f32 multiplication result30.000002. Initial cooldowns are not multiplied retroactively.

charge.target: Player XY with terrain-resolved Z; clip ray collision with half-unit backoff, then resolve endpoint terrain again.
charge.followup: Queue spell6343 centered at final endpoint, radius4.5, damage2*effective actor damage at arrival. Player range is checked when the deferred event resolves.

area_strike.behavior: Display the area spell and apply immediate player damage only if the current player is within radius8 in XY.

summon_minions.behavior: Before the adds, emit the yell from the guardian GUID. Add i uses angle i/4*TAU around guardian XY and ordinary enemy spawn; resolve each Z through ADT, WMO, then fallback.

bounded_native_validation.method: Original unchanged x86-64 helper and timer instructions in bounded Unicorn. Any external instructions/calls are rejected. No game/process or OS execution.
bounded_native_validation.source_comparison_test: Authored against the fixture; not run after final source additions.

remaining: Bind these rules to real entity, terrain/collision, movement/network and spell systems; source ports explicitly require those adapters.
Shared actor dead, stun, path, cast, aura and melee processing precedes these unique guardian behaviors and is not reconstructed by this module.
Original versus rebuilt live guardian behavior and visual/audio parity are unverified; the menu-only application has no playable world loop.
Cosf/sinf are original Windows CRT calls; cross-platform bit identity of transcendental results is not claimed.
Final source compilation, compiling tests and runtime checks were not run.
